name: compute-contract-gateway
description: Compute contract gateway — centralized endpoint over decentralized compute contract API

hostname.description: Hostname for DID document and service endpoint

private-key-hex.description: Secp256k1 private key hex for stable DID

private-key-hex-path.description: Path to load/save private key hex

pds-state-path.description: Path for persistent PDS state (Deno.Kv SQLite)

relay-urls.description: Comma-separated relay URLs for bidder discovery

tls-cert-file.description: PEM certificate to serve TLS with; requires tls-key-file

tls-key-file.description: PEM private key to serve TLS with; requires tls-cert-file

port-file.description: File the bound TCP port is written to once listening (used with port 0)
